subject.title: fix: channel setup succeeds when audit storage fails

question: Should completed hosted channel setup remain successful when only its subsequent system-agent audit persistence fails?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes whether an audit-write failure can negate a completed configuration operation; the protected maintainer label requires a human owner to accept that operational contract.

options.title: Accept best-effort audit persistence
options.body: Merge after refreshing the branch and confirming the focused fault-injection still preserves committed setup success while logging the audit failure.

options.title: Keep audit persistence fatal
options.body: Reject this behavior change and define a compensating or rollback contract for a completed channel setup whose audit record cannot be stored.

recommendation.title: Accept best-effort audit persistence
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshing the branch and confirming the focused fault-injection still preserves committed setup success while logging the audit failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the current repair, runtime evidence, and the most direct explanation of the completed-operation audit boundary.
